svg.aria-label: Exhibit: how a day's doodle is chosen and drawn
svg.title: Exhibit: how a day's doodle is chosen and drawn
svg.text: Code sets the menu. AI makes the call.
Python plans, gathers and checks. Smarter AI resources choose, judge and draw. A person approves new art.
Each region's menu: catalog, holidays, trends
Picks one item per region, and says why
On the menu? Blocked words, caption, link
A small LLM: is it plainly cheerful?
Draws the decorations, in flat SVG shapes
Allowlist: no scripts, links or url()
Approves new drawings, or rejects them
Reviewed catalog art needs no one.
catalog or default: shown at once
Any refusal or failure, at any step, keeps
the doodle that the calendar planned. Nothing
worse than the plain scene can reach the page.
Source: smarter.apps.doodle; smarter/ in smarter-sh/example-manifests. The sign-in page shows Japan's Culture Day.
